description: This file defines a class that manages a collection of referenced types, assigning and retrieving unique identifiers for types to facilitate serialization processes within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: ReferencedTypeCollection
classes.description: A collection that tracks types and their associated reference identifiers for serialization purposes in Orleans.

methods.name: GetReferencedType
methods.description: Retrieves the type associated with a specific reference id.

methods.name: TryGetReferencedType
methods.description: Attempts to fetch the type associated with a given reference id, indicating success or failure.

methods.name: RecordReferencedType
methods.description: Adds a new type to the collection, assigning it a new reference id.

methods.name: TryGetTypeReference
methods.description: Checks if a type has already been assigned a reference id.

methods.name: GetOrAddTypeReference
methods.description: Retrieves the reference id for a type or adds it if not present, utilizing a fast path for NET6.0+.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Clears the collection and resets the reference id counter.
